text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the dance studio, I<n>happen to spot
Shinko Windy and<n>King Halo practicing inside.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Phew! One, two, three, four!
choice_data_list: Are you having a dance lesson together?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Practicing alone's kinda<n>boring, so I
invited King! And I<n>definitely made the right call!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Her dancing's really cool! She's full<n>of confidence
and sinister pizzazz!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What?! Wh-who are you calling<n>sinister?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're built from the right stuff to<n>make a fine
charismatic villain!<n>Whaddya say to becomin' a big
bad<n>with me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...W-well, I can understand your<n>feelings of
admiration. Even in a<n>world of evil, someone
first-rate like<n>myself would no doubt rise to the top.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No way! The only one sitting on any<n>throne of evil is
gonna be Windy, the<n>wicked queen of tyranny!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: How dare you?! As a first-rateUmamusume, my aptitude for the darkarts is also first-rate! Only an evil kingis fit for an evil throne!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Growr! I'm the most nefarious villainin the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I challenge you! Let's settle which of<n>us is the
evilest with a dance-off!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Perfectly fine by me. Just be aware<n>that my victory
is guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I shall go first. Behold!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gah! She moves with such<n>confidence and ease.
Looks like<n>she's got a talent for wickedness!<n>But
get a load of this!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What unbelievably striking dance<n>moves! I see, so
this is what you're<n>capable of!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is a dance you<n>can't turn your
eyes away from—the<n>dance of evil!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now for the verdict! Hey, lackey! Who<n>was more
evil?!
choice_data_list: I guess I'd say King Halo...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wahaha! Not that anyone's<n>surprised!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...W-well, I never wanted to be evil in<n>the first place.
I'm not even bothered<n>that you won!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Your dancing was great, though, King!<n>I'll happily
appoint you as my evil<n>lieutenant if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gragh?! But why?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Even my aptitude for evil is<n>first-rate!
...Not that I have any interest<n>in becoming a villain.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, no fair! I'll definitely win next<n>time! I'm gonna
keep practicin' and<n>make my dancing even badder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vowing revenge on King Halo, Shinko<n>Windy
redoubles her efforts in dance<n>practice from this
day on.
